svg.title: Kept and dropped experts in four layers, ordered by the bot use
svg.text: Each column is one of the 216 experts of the layer, most used by the bot on the left.
Bar height: the share of the routed tokens of the layer, linear; the tallest bar is full height.
REAP rank drops at K 192 (24 per layer)
bot rank drops at K 160 (56 per layer)
